name: aidoctor
description: Python coding harness for AI agents. 7 skills + 1 CLI catch slop at four time-points: writing (python-rules auto-loads), diff review (/aidoctor:simplify), one-file scan (/aidoctor:scan), and whole-project audit (/aidoctor:audit). Plus /aidoctor:help for the catalog, /aidoctor:rules for the rule reference, and using-aidoctor orientation. Same skills work in Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode via `uvx aidoctor install`.
